answer: Proof of Personhood using a web-of-trust vertex model prevents Sybil attacks by requiring a cryptographic cedar of signed endorsements from established nodes. This creates a dense social graph where hollow accounts lacking valid human-linked attestation cannot gain influence. The attacker bears the high cost of acquiring legitimate social capital or bypassing biometric liveness checks to generate each new identity, rendering the massive duplication of identities economically prohibitive within the network.
